title: false-independence-from-common-control

proposition.statement: A relying system must not treat multiple evidence items as independent corroboration when they resolve to a common controlling authority or common dependency that materially undermines the independence claim.

preconditions: Two or more evidence items are presented as independent support for a proposition.
The evidence items share a controlling authority, dependency, or provenance path material to the proposition.
The relying decision gives additional weight because the evidence appears independent.

trigger.statement: The relying system aggregates separately presented evidence without evaluating whether the evidence sources are materially independent.

evidence_required.statement: Evidence describing dependencies and relationships among the evidence sources being composed.
Evidence sufficient to trace each asserted source to its controlling or originating authority.
Evidence identifying the authority or authorities whose control is material to the independence claim.

falsification.condition: The system returns PASS because it counts materially dependent evidence as independent corroboration.
The system cannot establish source independence but treats separate presentation as proof of independence.

references.note: Repository judgment record for the composition failure tranche.
